product_overview: Nextstep Careers is a marketing website for career services that helps visitors learn about the company, review its offerings and results, and get in touch with the team. The site presents service information, pricing, process details, testimonials, and a contact form for inquiries.
core_goals: Review past work, testimonials, and success stories
Understand the company’s process and pricing
Contact the team with an inquiry
Navigate between the main informational pages

features.name: Global Navigation
features.description: Visitors can move across the main sections of the website from a responsive navigation bar.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select an informational page from the navigation links -> View the chosen page
Navigate to / -> Open the primary call to action -> Move to the getting-started or contact path
Navigate to / -> Select the testimonials-related link -> View the social proof section

features.name: Company and Service Information Pages
features.description: Visitors can learn about the company, the services offered, the process used, and the pricing options.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> Review company background -> Learn more about Nextstep Careers
Navigate to /services -> Review the available services -> Understand what the company provides
Navigate to /process -> Review the step-by-step methodology -> Understand how the service is delivered
Navigate to /pricing -> Review the available plans -> Compare the pricing options

features.name: Portfolio and Social Proof
features.description: Visitors can review proof of past results, client testimonials, and success stories, including resume before-and-after comparisons.
user_flows: Navigate to /portfolio -> Review past work and success stories -> Evaluate the company’s results
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the proof-of-work section -> Review testimonials and performance stats -> Compare before and after resume views

features.name: Contact Form Submission
features.description: Visitors can send an inquiry to the team using the contact form.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in message -> Submit the inquiry form -> See confirmation feedback
Navigate to /contact -> Leave a required field incomplete or enter invalid details -> Submit the inquiry form -> See validation feedback
